title: Snowy Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Steal, Auto Sell, Speed & More
features:
Automation and farming

Auto Steal Loop – Automatically travels between the selected area, base, and sell zone to collect, deposit, and repeat.

Auto Sell – Automatically sells your inventory during the farming loop or as a standalone routine.

Custom Timers – Adjusts wait times for stealing, returning to base, and selling.

Auto Rebirth – Automatically triggers rebirths when the requirements are met.

2X Popup Clicker – Automatically detects and clicks 2X multiplier popups, with a Q key toggle.

Teleports and travel

Ground Locations – Teleports to the Base / Spawn and Sell Zone.

Sky Areas – Teleports to the Mythic Area, Prehistoric Area, and Celestial Heights.

Movement and character

Fast Fly – Enables adjustable flight with speeds up to 600 studs/s, with an F key toggle.

Super WalkSpeed – Sets custom movement speeds up to 400 studs/s.

Infinite Jump – Allows repeated jumping while airborne.

Noclip – Disables character collision to move through walls and obstacles.

Anti-AFK – Prevents the game from kicking you for inactivity.

Interface and settings

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the interface, defaulting to RightShift.

Notifications – Displays notifications when actions are successfully completed.

Unload – Completely removes the script from the game.
